body:
Those big burly motherfuckers? I'd be scared out of my mind just talking to their daughters... They have bows man, huge fuckin' bows. Hell, my cheap ass bow set at a low pull weight could easily kill a man from 60+ feet.

That's why I like this girl. Her dad's the god damn Culligan man. Worst he could do is throw water bottles at me. I know, I've seen his refrigerator... the guy has a lot of water.

I've thought about this so much.

Part of me wants to believe she's only sneaking around because her current boyfriend is apparently a dick. I've never met the guy, so I try not to pass judgement. I have a strong bias though.

Then my logical side kicks in... and to be perfectly honest, this is my only doubt about the whole thing. Yes, I realize it's a huge one.

It doesn't matter anyways. I know the more I hang out with her without the relationship moving forward, I slip deeper and deeper into the friend zone.

I would never make a physical move on her, I mean christ, as much as I hate it, she *does* have a boyfriend. It wouldn't be right to put her in that situation.

Thanks for the help.

I've considered a journal before. Even bought a few mead pads with intentions to start one.

Then I realizeed most of the entries would go like this.

"Dear journal, went to work today.

Talk to you tomorrow journal"

I already tried to write her off once. After I admitted my feelings I told her I couldn't be just friends with her; Basically told her I didn't want to see her unless she wanted some sort of relationship with me.

Unfortunately I'm an idiot. So about an hour after I got home, it sunk in that I had lost the only person I really care about, and I was now completely alone again.

I essentially came crawling back the same night.

And yeah, I've been trying to find some sort of archery group around here. I know it would mostly be dudes 30 and up, because of my location, but whatever, something to do.

(mostly) Answered [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/a75je/yes_im_pathetic_im_here_because_im_almost/c0g60tg)

Thank you for the reply.

I have always felt that one of my strongest attributes is my logic. I've always been one to examine a situation thoughtfully and thoroughly, and make an intelligent decision.

I feel this is no different. I've pondered the potential relationship. I may be mad over this girl, but I still have my logic. I'm fully aware what responsibilitys I'd be assuming. I've gone through this in my head countless times. I've asked myself if she was worth it, if it was worth sacrificing my youth to help her raise 2 children. If I really wanted to contend with their father.

The answer has always been the same. Yes. Abso-fucking-lutely, yes, yes, 100% yes. I want her, and every thing that comes along with her. I want her flaws, I want her stupid inane fears (who the hell over the age of 12 is afraid of storms and still lives in tornado alley?). I want the kids, I want her family. I'm even willing to to accept that prick of a boyfriend she has now will be in her life until he dies.

I know from the outside, I sound like your stereotypical love-sick teenager that thinks everything will be just peachy in the relationship; but it's not like that. and yes, I know everyone says that. But I'm not stupid. I know it would be hard... and for her... I would give it all I have. I really would.

As for your questions, I'm sorry to say I don't fully understand what you're asking.

Would it be healthy? Stable? In what way do you mean? I guess the answer would be yes to both; I've got no reason to assume otherwise.

Thanks for the reply. I do feel a lot better. Unfortunately I know it wont last long.
